caption.text: Your Postgres default silently allows lost updates and write skew, and it never tells you. This 10-page field handbook walks the whole stack: MVCC internals and xmin/xmax, what each of the three real isolation levels still permits, row locks and SKIP LOCKED queues, deadlock causes with their fixes, and advisory locks for the things that aren't rows. Ends with a decision tree, a retry contract, and the monitoring queries to prove you got it right.
